field_edits.updated_text: Oblique fracture of the distal fibula/lateral malleolus at the level of the ankle syndesmosis (Weber B pattern) is seen. Fracture alignment is maintained without significant interval displacement or angulation. Assessment of the fracture margins and osseous healing is limited by overlying plaster cast. Bone mineralization is normal.
Ankle mortise remains congruent without appreciable medial clear-space widening. Alignment is maintained.

impression:
1. Oblique fracture of the distal fibula/lateral malleolus (Weber B) at the ankle syndesmosis with maintained alignment.
2. Ankle mortise remains congruent.
